get.description: Retrieves the blocked bots setting from GoSquared.

get.description: Retrieves a person from GoSquared by ID.

parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

parameters.description: The unique identifier of the person whose feed should be retrieved.

parameters.description: Comma-delimited event types to include in the feed.
